messages.subject: Re: Incosistent behaviour of scale_x_discrete(labels=...)
parts:
You could get rid of the labels using substr() on all of your groups: 
df$shortnames<-substr(df$longnames,...)

then make df$shortnames an ordered factor:
df$shortnames<-factor(df$shortnames, levels=..., ordered=T)

This way you don't have to try and be too creative in ggplot. 

If I've misunderstood, please attach an example of what you're trying to accomplish. 

B


On Sat, Jul 21, 2012 at 4:47 PM, Fred Erik <frederik...@googlemail.com> wrote:
Hi guys,

I'm using numerical prefixes (01, 02, 03...) to order my groups. However, I want to get rid of it, when labeling the x-axis of a plot. I try to do so by using scale_x_discrete(labels=...) and substr(...). This works great with one single plot. When using facet_grid/wrap it does not work anymore because labeling of scale_x_discrete is different from standard labeling. When labeling 1:100 each plot begins at 1 while standard labeling adepts labeling to the variables given in facet_grid/wrap. Is this a misbehaviour or do I have to use a different labeling feature when using facet_grid/wrap.

Thank you very much,

Frederik
